aiReviewQueue.title: AI review queue
aiReviewQueue.subtitle: Jobs and events an automated check flagged. You have the final say.
aiReviewQueue.permissionBody: The AI review queue is available to university moderators only.
aiReviewQueue.adviceBody: An automated check flagged these items. Review each one and either uphold the flag (reject the item) or dismiss it.
aiReviewQueue.emptyBody: No items need human review right now.
aiReviewQueue.upholdBody: “{title}” will be rejected and the partner notified.
aiReviewQueue.dismissBody: The flag on “{title}” will be cleared and the item returns to normal review.
aiReviewQueue.reasonHint: This reason is recorded and shared with the partner.
aiReviewQueue.dismissReasonHint: This reason is recorded for the audit trail.
aiReviewQueue.goneBody: This item was already decided elsewhere. We've refreshed the queue.
